hints: A plain visited flag is not enough. You need to distinguish 'currently on the path I am standing on' from 'explored and finished'.
Three states: 0 untouched, 1 on the current recursion path, 2 finished. Set 1 on entry and 2 just before returning.
A neighbour coloured 1 is a back edge to something still open above you - that is the cycle. A neighbour coloured 2 is a finished subtree and is fine.
title: Cycle detection (directed): the three colours
